software.title: Blender 5.2.3 (GPU rendering)
software.summary: Blender with Cycles rendering on this device's GPU through Metal. A Windows Arm64 build; the first start compiles the render kernels (about 30 seconds).
software.notes: A kernel pack without GPU binaries for this device now leaves out transparent shadows instead of failing; the other kernels still come from the pack.

software.title: Blender GPU kernels for this device
software.summary: Render kernels built ahead of time for this device's GPU. Blender then starts rendering without compiling them on the phone, and scenes with transparent shadows render with the right shadows. Download it once; it is used by Blender automatically.
software.notes: For the iPad Pro (M4) on iPadOS 27.0. Also usable after a system update (without transparent shadows) until a pack for the new version is out.

software.title: Blender GPU kernels for this device
software.summary: Render kernels built ahead of time for this device's GPU. Blender then starts rendering without compiling them on the phone, and scenes with transparent shadows render with the right shadows. Download it once; it is used by Blender automatically.
software.notes: For the iPhone 15 Pro (A17 Pro) on iOS 27.2. Also usable after a system update (without transparent shadows) until a pack for the new version is out.

software.title: Blender GPU kernels (universal, test)
software.summary: A test: shader code built ahead of time that works on any GPU and system version. The phone only builds the GPU code from it. It replaces the device-specific kernels above; download those again to go back.
software.notes: Any device: the shader code only, GPU code built on the device, without transparent shadows.
